name: MyD Delivery
author: Eduardo Villão

sections.description:
MyD Delivery was built for restaurants, cafés, bakeries, dark kitchens, and any local businesses that want a fast and simple way to sell online.
Instead of relying on marketplaces or complicated e-commerce setups, you get a delivery system 100% inside WordPress — fully under your control.

Why MyD Delivery?

  • Quick setup – start receiving orders in minutes.
  • All-in-one – products, orders, and customers in one place.
  • Mobile-friendly checkout – your customers order easily from their phone.
  • Lightweight & independent – no external service, all data stays in your site.

With MyD Delivery, you can give your customers a smooth online ordering experience, while you manage everything directly in your WordPress dashboard.

Key Features (Free)

  • Unlimited products and categories
  • Orders management dashboard
  • Customer data storage
  • WhatsApp order sending
  • Mobile-friendly checkout
  • Extra product options (add-ons, combos, etc.)
  • Delivery by distance with MyD Maps
  • Customize the WhatsApp message
  • Reports

Learn more
sections.installation:
1. Install it directly from the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Access MyD Delivery in your WordPress admin menu to configure your products and delivery settings.
  4. (Optional) Connect your WhatsApp number to receive orders instantly.
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce to use MyD Delivery?

No. MyD Delivery works independently. It is a standalone system optimized for delivery.

Can I send orders directly to WhatsApp?

Yes. Customers can place orders and you receive them via WhatsApp for fast confirmation.

Where can I get support?

You can find documentation, tutorials, and support on MyD Delivery website.
